answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study at Amazon Mechanical Turk to confirm the effectiveness of WORDTOUR. Specifically, to compare two word ordering σ, τ ∈ P([n]), we randomly sample a reference word v ∈ V, retrieve the next words of v in σ and τ , and ask a crowdworker which word is more similar to the reference word v.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdworkers were asked to select which of two words (retrieved from different orderings) is more similar to a reference word.
